regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing semiconductor-led leadership structure: Memory/HBM & Storage heads the ranks with AI Infrastructure a close challenger, while only 43% of themes are trend-eligible and the rotation radar flags 'narrowing' breadth with no one-narrative dominance. The validated edge here is risk control only (gate_helps=true); momentum rank is a focus lens, rotation timing is display-only, and the 0.50 directional accuracy on 80 prior calls argues for low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching Semiconductors broadly (Memory + AI Infra + WFE + AI Semis all in the top 5) for a durability test: if the top-four semiconductor themes' combined leadership margin keeps narrowing while eligibility breadth stays near 0.43, the trade retires into 'regime intact, no new edge'; retire the watch if a single name takes clear one-narrative leadership with breadth above 0.9.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: This is the prevailing, highest-ranked narrative with firm breadth (0.75), trend eligibility, and no crowding flag (z=0.41). The absolute-trend gate supports staying long absent a breakdown; the rank gives focus, not a return forecast. Lean overlaps heavily with AI Infrastructure and Semiconductor Equipment via the SMH proxy, so treat as the core semiconductor complex.
evidence: gate_helps=true (trend discipline validated as drawdown control)
theses.dissent: Its 'mixed' Hurst tag undercuts trend persistence, and a 0.50 directional track record plus weak rank-IC means the lead is as likely attention as durable alpha; a sudden AI-capex digestion or memory pricing rollover would hit the whole complex.

falsifier.text: SMH breaks below its 50-day moving average on volume, or Memory/HBM & Storage lags AI Infrastructure by more than 4% before the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Second-ranked, trend-eligible theme with the broadest ownership (breadth=0.875) and comfortably uncrowded (z=0.78). It is the designated rotation challenger (score 2.132, margin 0.458 behind the leader). Supported only as a trend-following, vol-aware stance — not as a predicted handoff.
theses.dissent: Directional accuracy is coin-flip and rotation timing has no validated forward edge; the narrowing rotation view means multiple semiconductor themes are vying for the same pool of flow, so leadership could simply rotate back to Memory without a clean AI Infrastructure breakout.

falsifier.text: AI Infrastructure's SMH proxy lags the broader semiconductor complex by 3% or falls below its own 50-day average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: The only non-semiconductor in the top tier: trend-eligible with perfect breadth (1.0) and a 'trend' Hurst tag. Crowding is flagged (z=1.91), which per guardrails is a size-down caution only — never a fade. The trend gate supports staying long while the theme remains above its trend line.
evidence: crowding_z=1.91 -> crowded=true (sizing caution, not a sell)
theses.dissent: It is the most crowded theme in the top five by a wide margin; the guardrails explicitly warn not to treat attention spikes or crowding as bullish, and a crowded theme under a narrowing regime can deflate fast on any earnings disappointment.

falsifier.text: CIBR falls below its 50-day moving average, or Cybersecurity loses its perfect breadth (breadth drops below 0.7) before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
